checklist.notes: The language and task demands in the A1-U02-L01 LESSON are broadly appropriate for its declared CEFR tier.
No material English grammar, lexical, pronunciation-description, or meaning error was found in the reviewed A1-U02-L01 LESSON.
The reviewed A1-U02-L01 LESSON remains within its declared lesson references and communicative scope.
The substitution direction says to replace station with gate or home while retaining the frame “to the ___”; substituting home literally yields the ungrammatical phrase “to the home”.
The source sentences are otherwise natural, but the stated substitution operation can directly produce unnatural English.

No suspiciously distinctive copied passage is apparent in the short A1-U02-L01 LESSON, but internal inspection cannot establish originality beyond the retained project evidence and no Internet-wide comparison was performed.

findings.description: The substitution task does not account for the article and preposition pattern required by home.
findings.recommendation: Give complete alternatives such as “to the gate” and “home”, or instruct learners to remove both to and the before home.

limitations: This review covers only the immutable A1-U02-L01 LESSON and its fresh static machine-report context. It does not assess human or release approval, provider authentication, live-provider behavior, learner outcomes, or Internet-wide originality.
